name: Dapagliflozin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Dapagliflozin is a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor. For kidney and heart protection the US label allows starting at an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 25 mL/min/1.73 m2 or higher and continuing below 25; for glucose lowering alone it is not recommended below eGFR 45. Guidelines (KDIGO 2024, ADA-KDIGO 2022) support starting at eGFR ≥20 and continuing until intolerance or kidney replacement therapy.

bands.recommendation: No adjustment. Chronic kidney disease (CKD), heart failure and cardiovascular indications: 10 mg once daily. Glycemic control: start 5 mg once daily.
CKD, heart failure and cardiovascular indications: 10 mg once daily. Glycemic control: not recommended if eGFR <45 (likely ineffective).

eGFR 25–29: may start 10 mg once daily for CKD, heart failure or cardiovascular indications. eGFR <25: do not start; patients already on it may continue 10 mg once daily (label). Not for glycemic control. Guidelines (KDIGO 2024, ADA-KDIGO 2022) support starting SGLT2 inhibitors at eGFR ≥20 (off-label for dapagliflozin at 20–24) and continuing below 20 until intolerance or kidney replacement therapy.
Do not start. May continue 10 mg once daily if started earlier (label: continue if eGFR falls below 25). Not for glycemic control.
bands.short: Do not start; may continue 10 mg

hd.text: Not studied; trials did not enroll patients on dialysis. Trial patients who started dialysis were not required to stop (label). Effect of hemodialysis on exposure is unknown. Guidelines advise continuing until kidney replacement therapy begins (ADA-KDIGO); not effective for glucose lowering on dialysis. Specialist input.
hd.short: Not studied; guidelines: stop at KRT

pd.text: Not studied (label). Insufficient data: specialist input.

crrt.text: No data in label. Insufficient data: specialist input; usually held in acute illness.

dialyzable: Unknown: removal by hemodialysis has not been studied (label).
monitoring: Assess kidney function and volume status before starting; correct volume depletion. Expect an early small eGFR dip. Withhold at least 3 days before surgery or prolonged fasting (label); watch for ketoacidosis.

pediatric.approved_ages: Type 2 diabetes glycemic control: 10 years and older. Not established under 10 years, and not established in children for CKD, heart failure or cardiovascular indications (label).
pediatric.usual_dose: Type 2 diabetes, 10 years and older: start 5 mg orally once daily (label gives a fixed dose, not mg/kg). Maximum per label 10 mg once daily.

renal.recommendation: eGFR 45–59: usual dose. eGFR <45: not recommended for glycemic control (label applies to adult and pediatric patients).

pediatric.neonates: Neonates: not applicable (not established under 10 years).
pediatric.notes: Pediatric kidney-protection use is not established; any such use is specialist off-label practice.
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)
